candidate.text: Added a new annotation `sidecar.istio.io/native-side` to allow users to control native sidecar injection on a per-pod basis. This annotation can be set to `true` or `false` to enable or disable native sidecar injection for a pod. This annotation takes precedence over the global ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS environment variable.

evidence.excerpt:
- |
  **Added** a new annotation `sidecar.istio.io/native-side` to allow users to control native sidecar injection on a per-pod basis. This annotation can be set to `true` or `false` to enable or disable native sidecar injection for a pod. This annotation takes precedence over the global ENABLE_NATIVE_SIDECARS environment variable.
